caption: The drawing depicts a single ornate door knocker centered on a plain, light beige background. The door knocker is vertically oriented and is composed of dark brown metal with gold accents highlighting its intricate design. The top of the knocker features a castle-like crown shape with a rectangular base containing a circular hole, beneath which there is a symmetrical floral motif. Extending downward are two curved, leaf-like forms that mirror each other, framing a central vertical element decorated with additional leaf patterns and scrollwork. The whole knocker design exhibits detailed engraving and molding, giving it a three-dimensional appearance. In the lower left corner of the drawing, the name "John. H. Tercuzzi." is printed in small, gray, uppercase letters.
title: Door Knocker
